Collector first. Seller second. · Victoria, Australia · Selling since 2023 · 1.5K sold, 100% positive

Feedback figures are from our eBay store.

Authenticity guaranteed. Every sealed item we sell comes direct from our Japanese distributor. If it isn't genuine, you get a full refund.

Pokemon Abyss Eye (M5) Sealed Japanese Booster Box

  • Authentic Japanese print
  • Factory sealed
  • Import freight from Japan is included in the price. Dispatched tracked from Victoria within 2–4 business days. Postage within Australia: $15.25 tracked, free on orders of $250 or more.
  • Item origin: Japan

How to spot a fake

  • Genuine Japanese boxes come in printed outer shrink (Pokémon Card Game or Bandai logos) with one clean heat seal. Clear unprinted wrap or a double seam is a red flag.
  • Inside, every pack has crisp, even crimps and the same set code. Glossy, off-colour or mismatched packs are not factory.
  • "No Outer Shrink" boxes won't have the printed wrap — the packs are what to check.
  • Anything look off? Send us a photo before opening and we'll sort it.

Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery if the item is not as described. Sealed and international orders are final sale. This doesn't limit your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
